attractions.name: George Town UNESCO Heritage Walk
attractions.description: Living museum of colonial-era shophouses, clan homes and vibrant street life blending Chinese, Malay, Indian and European influences
tips: Best explored in the morning to avoid heat

attractions.name: Kek Lok Si Temple
attractions.description: One of Southeast Asia's largest Buddhist temple complexes, with pagodas, prayer halls, hilltop views and a towering Goddess of Mercy statue.
attractions.entry_fee: Entry free; inclinator/elevator ~MYR 2–6 (paid on the spot)
attractions._source_file: Singapore and Malaysia/Shubhi and Rochak_Malaysia_All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Penang Hill Funicular
attractions.description: Funicular railway ascending through lush rainforest to Penang Hill, with cooler air and panoramic views.
tips: Large paid parking at base station
attractions._source_file: Singapore and Malaysia/Shubhi and Rochak_Malaysia_All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Penang Hill
attractions.description: Hilltop with sweeping views of George Town, the coastline and the mainland.
